origin: RSC Motorsport emerged from the dusty streets of Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, in the late 1990s. It wasn't born from corporate sponsorship or wealthy benefactors, but rather from the sheer passion of Ricardo Silva Carvalho (RSC), a local mechanic with an insatiable love for speed. Ricardo, along with a handful of equally enthusiastic friends, initially tinkered with old VW Beetles, transforming them into surprisingly competitive hill climb racers. Their humble beginnings involved scavenging parts from junkyards and welding late into the night, fueled by cheap coffee and the thrill of competition. A pivotal moment came when they secured a surprise victory at a regional rallycross event, proving that raw talent and determination could overcome limited resources.
philosophy: RSC Motorsport's racing philosophy is rooted in simplicity, reliability, and a relentless pursuit of improvement. They prioritize maximizing the potential of readily available technology rather than chasing expensive, cutting-edge solutions. Their approach to car development is hands-on and iterative, constantly experimenting and refining their designs based on real-world feedback. The team culture is one of camaraderie, mutual respect, and a shared passion for motorsport, fostering a supportive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
achievements: Surprise victory at the Ribeirão Preto Rallycross (2003)
Multiple class wins in the São Paulo Hill Climb Championship (2005-2008)
Podium finish in the Brazilian Endurance Series (Amateur Class, 2012)
Consistent top-10 finishes in regional touring car races

teamPrincipal.name: Ricardo Silva Carvalho
teamPrincipal.background: Ricardo, a self-taught mechanic, is the heart and soul of RSC Motorsport. His hands-on approach and unwavering dedication inspire the team, fostering a family-like atmosphere despite the pressures of competition.

keyFigures.name: Maria Santos Oliveira
keyFigures.description: Maria is Ricardo's right-hand person and a master of improvisational engineering. She's renowned for her ability to fix anything with limited resources.

headquarters: RSC Motorsport operates out of a modest workshop located on the outskirts of Ribeirão Preto. The facility is basic, but functional, housing a small fabrication area, a few work bays, and a cramped office space filled with trophies and memories.
fanBase: RSC Motorsport enjoys a loyal following among local racing enthusiasts, who appreciate their gritty determination and their willingness to challenge the established order. Their fans are primarily working-class individuals who identify with the team's underdog spirit and their commitment to grassroots motorsport.
